<!--DESCRIPTION
|   Egg and rice breakfast
|____________________________________________________________________-->

This breakfast might sound a little weird, but it's super tasty and high in protein.

## Ingredients

3 oz cooked egg white
1/2 c shelled edamame

1/2 c cooked rice

1/4 c plain greek yogurt
squirt of sriracha sauce
2 t olive oil
salt

## Protein Content

25g protein

### Breakdown

10g - egg
10g - edamame
 5g - yogurt
